boundaries.credentialRuntimeIdentity: The approved target is identity-worker; the compatibility app-process root and the full rollup command set must be removed or separately approved before activation.
boundaries.authoritativeScopeSource: An allowlisted SystemCheckpoint key under the analytics distributed lease; the checkpoint is platform operational state and has no tenant or human actor scope.
activationBlockers: The full analytics rollup root also performs high-risk cross-tenant reads and writes that are outside this bounded read review.
The compatibility backend app-process root does not prove the dedicated worker credential.
Durable checkpoint, lease, idempotency and same-transaction command behavior are not yet certified.
requiredTests: Dedicated worker runtime identity and compatibility-root denial
Exact checkpoint-key allowlist and no generic cross-tenant read
Lease ownership, idempotent retry and checkpoint ordering
No human role, tenant wildcard or platform-admin context

boundaries.credentialRuntimeIdentity: A fresh signed connector request bound to one non-revoked PrinterRegistration; the database runtime still requires a dedicated approved device-claim contract before activation.
boundaries.authoritativeScopeSource: Verified agentId, deviceFingerprint and public-key signature bind PrinterRegistration.id/userId; candidate printer IDs must belong to that registration and manufacturerId is the verified registration userId.
activationBlockers: The count is part of a larger claim lifecycle with protected reads and mutations that are not one canonical transaction.
A durable nonce/replay and exact device-claim database boundary is not yet certified.
The count helper currently accepts caller-shaped printerIds and manufacturerId instead of a verified boundary object.
requiredTests: Exact device, registration, manufacturer and printer binding
Expired, replayed, revoked and foreign-device denial
Same-client claim count, reservation and state transition ordering
One-time claim and concurrent single-winner behavior
